subject: How to create a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome

messages.author: 205e65236658be25
messages.subject: How to create a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome
parts:
Hi.

I would like to make a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome.

But, when I ran the code below, both thresholds is displayed on all chromosomes.

data <- calc.genoprob(data, step=1, error.prob=0.001)
out.1 <- scanone(data, pheno.col=1, method="hk")
operm.1 <- scanone(data, pheno.col=1, method="hk",n.perm = 1000,perm.Xsp = TRUE,verbose = F,n.cluster = 6)
summary(operm.1, alpha = 0.05)
summary(operm.1, alpha = 0.10)

summary(out.1, perms=operm.1, alpha=0.05, pvalues=TRUE)
summary(out.1, perms=operm.1, alpha=0.10, pvalues=TRUE)

plot(out.1, alternate.chrid=T)
abline(h = summary(operm.1, alpha = 0.05),col = "red")
abline(h = summary(operm.1, alpha = 0.10),col = "blue")

Can I display only autosomal threshold on autosomal graphs and sex chromosomal thresholds on sex chromosomal graphs?

Thank you for your help.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: How to create a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome
parts:
Use the function add.threshold()

    add.threshold(out.1, perms=operm.1, alpha=0.05, col="red")
    add.threshold(out.1, perms=operm.1, alpha=0.10, col="blue")

karl
